research_question: Does Double DQN improve food13 performance or descriptive training stability relative to Standard DQN?
hypothesis: Double DQN has higher mean greedy food score across matched independent training seeds; improvement is not assumed.
primary_outcome: Mean food items per greedy evaluation episode; aggregate as the mean of three independent training-seed means.
training_seed_schedule: training_seed_starts[str(seed)]+episode_index; matched within A/B pair; smoke starts600000

analysis.comparison: B minus A paired by training seed
analysis.checkpoint_selection: final only; no seed or checkpoint selection

food_distance_definition: dx=(food_x-head_x)/(width-1); dy=(food_y-head_y)/(height-1); positive right/down; float32; current visible food only; no food => zero offsets.
budget_definition: Exactly100000 interactions per fresh model; episode safety bound100000 cannot stop earlier than the move cap. No snapshots chosen retrospectively.
seed_audit_note: Requested model seed211 was used in5G smoke. Under the authorised no-overlap rule, freeze unused244/255/266 for training and288 for smoke. Audit eval970000-970099, smoke980000-980004 and all new food blocks against earlier recorded seeds before training.

diagnostic.definition: For each nonterminal,nontruncated recorded next-state: max Q_online minus Q_target evaluated at argmax Q_online. Pool recorded states from both algorithms/all three seeds; every trained estimator receives exactly the same complete pool. Descriptive estimator disagreement, not proof of overestimation bias.
